name: workflow-yaml-guard
title: Workflow YAML Guard
description: Stops a GitHub Actions workflow handing your repo to anyone who opens a pull request by flagging pull_request_target or workflow_run jobs that check out the PR's code (pwn requests), untrusted ${{ github.event.* }} and head_ref pasted into run scripts, actions pinned to movable tags, missing or write-all token permissions, secrets echoed, dumped with toJSON or transformed past log masking, and self-hosted runners fork PRs can reach, following GitHub Security Lab and GitHub's secure-use docs, with one-tap fixes (env indirection, read-only permissions, pull_request, a hosted runner) and Pin SHA through your own lookup.
